## What and why

What does this PR change, and what problem does it solve? Keep it short. If it closes an issue, link it.

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New tool or exercise
- [ ] Notes or cheat sheet
- [ ] Refactor or folder reorganization
- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] CI, tests or tooling

## Where

Which module or tool does this touch? (for example `04-security-operations/exercises/log-analyzer`)

## How I tested it

What did you run and what did you see? Paste the relevant output if it helps a reviewer.

- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes (and I added a test if the change has logic that can be tested offline)
- [ ] `shellcheck -S error` passes on any Bash script I changed
- [ ] I ran the tool by hand in a lab or VM, not against a system I don't own

## Checklist

- [ ] New tools and exercises have a `README.md` with usage and an example
- [ ] Folder and file names follow the convention: lowercase, hyphens for folders, snake_case for scripts
- [ ] Links point to the right files (CI checks this too)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, real targets or personal data in the code, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Offensive or dual-use code says clearly that it is for authorized testing only
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if this is a user-facing change

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything you want a second opinion on, or anything you left out on purpose.
